<style>
  .hs_cos_wrapper_type_form,
  .hs-form-private,
  .hbspt-form {
    max-width: 560px !important;
    width: 100% !important;
    margin-left: auto !important;
    margin-right: auto !important;
    display: block !important;
    padding-top: 50px !important;
    padding-bottom: 50px !important;
  }
  .hs-form label {
    color: #012638 !important; font-size: 13px !important; font-weight: 600 !important;
    letter-spacing: .04em !important; text-transform: uppercase !important;
    margin-bottom: 6px !important; display: block !important; text-align: left !important;
  }
  .hs-form fieldset { max-width: 100% !important; }
  .hs-form input[type="text"],
  .hs-form input[type="email"],
  .hs-form input[type="tel"],
  .hs-form textarea,
  .hs-form select {
    width: 100% !important; background: white !important;
    border: 1px solid #c0cdd6 !important; border-radius: 4px !important;
    padding: 12px 14px !important; font-size: 15px !important;
    color: #012638 !important; margin-bottom: 20px !important;
    box-sizing: border-box !important; text-align: left !important;
  }
  .hs-form input:focus, .hs-form textarea:focus {
    outline: none !important; border-color: #6BA644 !important;
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(107,166,68,.15) !important;
  }
  .hs-form textarea { min-height: 100px !important; }
  .hs-form input[type="submit"], .hs-form .hs-button {
    background: #6BA644 !important; color: white !important;
    border: none !important; border-radius: 4px !important;
    padding: 16px 40px !important; font-size: 16px !important;
    font-weight: bold !important; letter-spacing: .5px !important;
    cursor: pointer !important; display: block !important;
    width: 100% !important; margin-top: 8px !important;
  }
  .hs-form input[type="submit"]:hover, .hs-form .hs-button:hover { background: #5a9038 !important; }
  .hs-form .hs-error-msgs { list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
  .hs-form .hs-error-msgs li { color: #c0392b; font-size: 12px; margin-top: -14px; margin-bottom: 8px; }
  .hs-form-private .form-title, .hbspt-form .form-title,
  .hs_cos_wrapper_type_form .form-title {
    color: #012638 !important; font-size: 22px !important;
    font-weight: bold !important; text-align: center !important;
    display: block !important; margin-bottom: 24px !important;
  }
</style>
<!-- DVL-PL-FORM:END -->
htmlTitle: Thank You for Starting Onboarding | Praxera Private Label

params.headline: Your onboarding guide is on the way.
params.subhead: Schedule a consultation with a private label specialist to walk through your guide, clarify next steps, and map out your product launch.

params.headline: How a typical onboarding goes.
params.subhead: Every client engagement follows the same five-phase process — from your first conversation to your first shipment. Here is a high-level view of what to expect over your first 90 days.

cards.content: Initial deep-dive on your audience, goals, and product vision.
cards.title: Kickoff Call

cards.content: Finalize your SKU list and share brand assets with design.
cards.title: Product Selection

cards.content: Design iteration until you approve. Approval starts production.
cards.title: Label Approval

cards.content: Completion of your brand products in our FDA-registered, cGMP certified facility.
cards.title: Production

cards.content: Product ships to your warehouse. Time to start selling.
cards.title: Launch

params.section_subhead: A high-level view of the milestones ahead. Your specialist will walk through each phase in detail.

params.content: A 30-minute working session with a private label specialist. We will walk through your guide, your audience, and exactly what it takes to get your product to market.
params.headline: Schedule a consultation.

params.title: Fill Out the Form to Get Your Consultation

params.content:
With over 50 years in the health supplement industry, we are one of the most trusted dietary supplement providers. Every private label supplement we produce is doctor-formulated using thoroughly researched ingredients, then scientifically reviewed for efficacy and quality before it ever enters production in our U.S. facilities.

Praxera is a division of FoodScience Corp, an FDA-registered food facility, GMP certified to SQF food safety standards, and certified to NSF GMP 455-2.

When you partner with us, our expert team is with you every step of the way. Help your customers find what they want from a source they trust. You.
params.headline: Developed by us. Made for you.

metaDescription: Your private label onboarding request is in. Our team will reach out within one business day to schedule your kickoff call.
